I have fixed the issue where tags from one call showed up in later calls.

### Root Cause
`add_tag` used a mutable default argument (`tags=[]`), which meant the same list object was shared across multiple function calls when the `tags` argument was omitted. 

### Fix
Changed the default value of `tags` to `None` and instantiated a new list inside the function body (`if tags is None: tags = []`) so that each call uses an independent list when no tags are provided.
